summary: Medium-range active-radar air-to-air missile, inertial midcourse with datalink updates

guidance_capabilities.note: Explicit engineering receive-fit declaration from this card's authored guidance. Enabled launcher updates execute through the native release-bound finite transport and accepted platform fusion; false does not assert hardware absence. A return transmitter is enabled only by a separately sourced exact variant/launcher profile. Numeric transport, navigation and feedback policies remain disclosed engineering assumptions, not calibrated equipment performance.

guidance: inertial midcourse with datalink updates, terminal active radar homing
motor: solid rocket, booster only (C-5 on), reduced-smoke HTPB
fuze: Target detecting device; separate FZU-49 safe/arm device; configured ideal proximity/contact simulator model

power_up_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

power_down_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

explosive_kg.note: Retained7.17kg engineering fill proxy. Government VA49 NEWQD is15.8000lb=7.166759446kg; NEWQD is hazard accounting, not proof of chemical fill. No calibrated PBXN-110 fill mass is claimed; no value was selected from hit outcomes.

gurney_kms.note: PBXN-110 (88 % HMX in a polymer binder) is not in Cooper's table: between Comp B (2.70) and LX-14 (2.80, 95 % HMX) less its larger binder share - an estimate

drag_area_m2.note: Engineering estimate A_D = CD_simulated*S_geometry at neutral Mach .3. Inputs, dated model-specific searches and method limits are in hangar-vlm.simulation and the evidence catalog. Assumed one-sigma screening uncertainty is |A_D| in m2; its coverage probability is not established. Equipment drag error remains unknown; the table evidence basis is simulated.

warhead_net_explosive_weight_qd_kg.note: VA49 quantity-distance net explosive weight only; not a replacement for chemical fill.

warhead_model_version.note: Explicit finite-source V2 model selection, fixed from a reviewed generic game-reference angular profile before encounter evaluation; not hardware calibration.

warhead_fragment_source.note: V2 combines the existing finite annular source with the complete pinned seven-sector game angular field. Uniform solid-angle interpolation within each sector and common position/ejection azimuth are generic assumptions; no measured WDU-41 field is asserted.

warhead_station_x_m.note: Structural metres aft/right/up from the authored nose. x nominal3.66*((549+632)/2-138)/(1135-138)=1.661m, rounded1.66; Hughes early-family armament schematic transferred to C-7 as an assumption. The0.18m assigned model standard uncertainty is not a measured C-7 confidence bound.

warhead_station_y_m.note: Axisymmetric source centre on the authored missile axis; an explicit generic geometry assumption, not measured C-7 installation data.

warhead_station_z_m.note: Axisymmetric source centre on the authored missile axis; an explicit generic geometry assumption, not measured C-7 installation data.

warhead_structure_fraction.note: Retained generic share of non-explosive mass for safe/arm, booster and end structures; no measured WDU-41 mass allocation.

warhead_diameter_ratio.note: Retained generic outer case diameter / missile diameter; source envelope is validated inside the authored body.

warhead_case_density_kg_m3.note: Retained generic steel-case material idealization; actual WDU-41 fragment material/construction is not calibrated.

warhead_explosive_density_kg_m3.note: Retained generic cast explosive bulk density used for the source-volume estimate; not a published PBXN-110 lot density.

warhead_structure_density_kg_m3.note: Retained generic aluminium-like safe/arm/structure density for volume budgeting; not a hardware composition claim.

warhead_fragment_cd.note: Retained constant tumbling-cube drag approximation; no Mach-dependent WDU-41 calibration.

weapon_execution_version.note: Explicit SDK execution schema1; frozen per actual release.

guidance_algorithm.note: Velocity-normal PN with closing-speed gain. Supported mathematical convention, not a claim about classified AIM-120 software.

guidance_navigation_gain.note: Retained engineering navigation ratio; no scene-fit or manufacturer calibration.

guidance_activation_ratio.note: Retained generic activation range / seeker acquisition range.

control_algorithm.note: Reduced-order load-feedback cascade using signed native aerodynamic derivatives; generates actuator commands only.

control_allocator.note: Authored native fin mixer with actual lag, rate, stops and failure states; no ideal-force fallback.

control_max_incidence_deg.note: Retained small-incidence engineering bound for the reduced-order model; not a published missile aerodynamic limit.

control_rate_time_min_s.note: Retained inner-loop minimum response time; independent engineering controller design assumption.

control_rate_lag_multiplier.note: Retained native actuator time-constant multiplier for inner response.

control_incidence_time_min_s.note: Retained outer-loop minimum response time; not an equipment measurement.

seeker_acquire_m.note: Retained generic native acquisition-range assumption; not a calibrated seeker range.

seeker_gimbal_deg.note: Retained generic active-radar seeker gimbal assumption.

guidance_max_g.note: Retained generic guidance demand limit; native fin/aerodynamic authority can realize less.

guidance_life_s.note: Retained generic guidance/battery execution lifetime assumption.

fuze_model_version.note: Explicit ideal simulator initiation schema1, distinct from hardware safe/arm/TDD identity.

fuze_proximity_algorithm.note: Actual captured turning-point CPA inside the admitted radius, not an approaching endpoint clamped to a decision boundary.

fuze_arming_s.note: Retained generic one-second arming assumption; no published FZU-49 timing is asserted.

fuze_radius_m.note: Retained generic point-reference detection radius from the prior7+sqrt(warhead_kg) rule, now explicit. It is not a published RF sensitivity or lethality radius.

fuze_delay_s.note: Selected zero-delay ideal simulator model. Hardware detection-to-burst latency is uncalibrated; no delay was fitted to these scenes.

fuze_station_x_m.note: Generic material sensor reference derived from the Hughes early-family TDD schematic midpoint525..548 relative to nose138/tail1135. Not an RF phase-centre measurement or C-7 installation calibration.

fuze_station_y_m.note: Axisymmetric ideal sensor reference, structural metres right from authored nose.

fuze_station_z_m.note: Axisymmetric ideal sensor reference, structural metres up from authored nose.

warhead_tnt_equivalent_kg.note: Independent generic blast TNT-equivalent input. Retains the prior nominal blast magnitude; the former Gurney-ratio heuristic is not evidence of physical TNT equivalence. Fragment Gurney-speed changes no longer silently change blast yield. No WDU-41/PBXN-110 blast calibration is claimed.

control_actuator_lag_s.note: Retained native first-order actuator time constant (former fixed coefficient25/s). An explicit generic plant assumption, not an AIM-120 equipment measurement.

control_actuator_rate_rad_s.note: Retained native physical-fin slew limit. An explicit generic plant assumption; native fin states, stops and failures remain authoritative.

method_sources: Katz and Plotkin, Low-Speed Aerodynamics, vortex lattice
Shared aero/model.py, tables.py and mach.py; engineering extensions are not equipment measurements

limitations: Generic AGARD-B geometry, not any of the 88 authored equipment models.
The publication pools facilities/model sizes and includes M0.8/M1.2 runs with the M0.77/M1.17 groups; no common Reynolds condition is supplied.
Body-normal force is derived as CN=CLf*cos(alpha)+CDf*sin(alpha), cancelling axial base-pressure force; reported CZ=-CN.
The 4% biconvex wing uses the existing shared section; its tiny specified leading-edge radius is not separately resolved.
Density/Reynolds and sting/wall interference differences remain. Residuals are not an equipment confidence interval.
No beta, dynamic derivative, powered flow or extreme-angle qualification follows from these conditions.

uncertainty.method: Coupled vortex-lattice/body/section/rate solution, common Mach extensions and common JSBSim tables; retained overrides are listed separately.
uncertainty.table_domain: Actual Mach/alpha/beta bounds are read from the generated product in hangar-vlm.simulation; no narrowing of the authored envelope.
uncertainty.uncertainty_basis: assumed engineering screening range, not measured equipment error or a probabilistic confidence interval
uncertainty.uncertainty_formula: Inside the generic comparison conditions: max(1,2*generic_NRMSE/100); outside them no finite equipment-error bound is established.
uncertainty.boundaries: Generic validation cannot identify equipment-specific separated flow, powered flow, Reynolds effects or extreme-angle errors; those remain unknown.
uncertainty.uncertainty_application: Assumed screening envelope only, not a measured model error or statistical bound. Applies to generic CZ/Cm comparison conditions; no finite equipment-error bound outside those conditions and no calibrated CD/CY/Cl/Cn uncertainty.
uncertainty.input_assumptions: Author-declared geometry and shared section/body correlations. Surface sections, sweep, twist, controls, body stations, mass/CG, analysis speed and all retained overrides are readable in aircraft/aim120c/aim120c.toml. Product extrema are generation coverage, not a validated physical domain.

simulation_model.calibration: AIM-120C-7 AMRAAM is uncalibrated. The C-7 bulk mass/span lineage is distinct from the assumed WDU-41/FZU-49 internal reconstruction. Its turning-CPA sensor station and finite V2 annulus/count, rather than a V0 point initiation or free fragment cloud, require their own burst timing and fragment-spectrum validation. Retained card anchors: mass 161.5 kg (published; source usn-aim120; uncertainty 1.0), length 3.66 m (published; source usaf-aim120; uncertainty 0.01), diameter 0.1778 m (published; source usaf-aim120; uncertainty 0.001), warhead 20.0 kg (published; source wp-aim120; uncertainty 2.0), explosive 7.17 kg (assumed; source usmc-yellowbook-va49; uncertainty 1.08). Current receiver rf_signal.v1; control fsim.control.load_feedback_cascade; propulsion fsim.propulsion.jsbsim_generated_solid_rocket; fuze native.fuze.turning_cpa.v1; warhead native.warhead.finite_zoned_case.v2. Current finite RF aperture/waveform and delivered-support PN are engineering instruments; the C-7 receiver, actuator and WDU-41 geometry are not fitted hardware response curves. Source classes and uncertainty records remain unchanged; assumed, derived and game-reference values are not promoted to equipment measurements. Per-model theory, parameter deltas and numerical method routes are in docs/research/sim-m03/component-methods/per-model-effects-components.json and per-model-six-components.json; the separate docs/research/sim-m03/calibration-ledger.json identifies the remaining equipment comparisons. Arithmetic or native scenario verification does not establish held-out accuracy. No admitted same-model independent baseline-to-new held-out calibration receipt is claimed; engineering completion continues through its own gates.
simulation_model.burst_reference: Fixed material station from the authored nose; Hughes early-family schematic midpoint transferred as an assumption.
simulation_model.fragmentation: Finite annular origins, exact case mass and equivalent cubes, with a complete pinned seven-sector generic game angular field; not a measured WDU-41 distribution.
simulation_model.guidance_control: Configured velocity-normal PN, reduced-order load-feedback cascade and authored native fin mixer.
simulation_model.contact: Frictionless perfectly inelastic rigid-body point impulse; no calibrated ballistic penetration or fracture solver.
